description.zh: 目标数据表映射字段列表。
description.en: Target data table mapping field list.

description.zh: kafka中的数据与adbpg目标表不匹配造时会造成写入失败，此值为允许错误行的行数，超出后会造成任务失败。
description.en: When data in Kafka does not match the ADBPG target table, it will cause a write failure. This value is the number of error rows allowed; exceeding this will cause the task to fail.

description.zh:
FallbackOffset 回退点位，回退偏移量

- FallbackOffset参数定义了当consumer没有请求需要消费的位点或者请求的消费的位点超出当前kafka集群的记录的位点信息的时候的行为。可以选择从earliest（最新）或者latest（最晚）位点开始消费。
description.en:
FallbackOffset, fallback offset

- The FallbackOffset parameter defines the behavior when the consumer does not request a specific offset or the requested offset exceeds the current Kafka cluster's recorded offset information. You can choose to start consuming from the earliest (newest) or latest (oldest) offset.

description.zh: 任务配置文件，专业模式必填。
description.en: Job configuration file, required for professional mode.

description.zh: 匹配列，通常为目标表的所有主键列，此配置内所有列的值相同即视为两行数据为重复数据。
description.en: Match columns, usually all primary key columns of the target table. If all column values in this configuration are the same, the two rows of data are considered duplicates.

description.zh:
配置模式
1. basic模式需要指定一些配置字段
1. professional支持提交yaml文件
description.en:
Configuration mode
1. Basic mode requires specifying some configuration fields
1. Professional mode supports submitting a YAML file

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
Region ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) API to view available region IDs.

description.zh:
是否测试实时任务，取值：

- true

- false

默认值：false。
description.en:
Whether to test the real-time task, values:

- true

- false

Default value: false.

description.zh: 更新列，通常为目标表的所有非主键列，当通过MatchColumns确定数据重复时，通过更新UpdateColumns列的值，产生使新数据覆盖旧数据的效果。
description.en: Update columns, usually all non-primary key columns of the target table. When data is determined to be duplicate through MatchColumns, updating the UpdateColumns column values will result in new data overwriting old data.
